q: Zubov's method constructs the exact domain of attraction D(0) of an asymptotically stable equilibrium as the sublevel set {V < 1} of a function V satisfying a specific PDE. The PDE is:
exp: Zubov's PDE: ∇V(x)·f(x) = −h(x)(1−V(x)) with boundary condition V → 1 as x → ∂D. The solution V ∈ [0,1) in D, V = 1 on ∂D, giving the exact boundary of the domain of attraction. Unlike standard Lyapunov functions, Zubov's gives the exact (not merely an estimate of) the domain.
